what_is.heading: What Are Minecoins and What Can You Buy With Them?
paragraphs: Minecoins are the currency for the Minecraft Marketplace in Bedrock Edition. You spend them on skins, texture packs, worlds, mash-ups and add-ons made by Marketplace creators.
Java Edition doesn't use Minecoins. They work on Bedrock for Windows, Xbox, PlayStation, Nintendo Switch, Android and iOS.

official_prices.heading: Minecoins Prices: Official Store vs DropMarket
official_prices.note: These are US prices. Bigger packs work out a little cheaper per coin.

delivery.heading: How Minecoins Delivery Works
steps: Pick an offer for your platform.
After checkout, the seller sends a Minecoins code in the order chat.
Redeem it at minecraft.net/redeem, signed in to the Microsoft account you play with.
Open the Marketplace, check your balance, then confirm the order.

support_topic.heading: Do Minecoins Work on Every Platform?
paragraphs: Mostly. Minecoins linked to your Microsoft account follow you to any Bedrock device you sign in on.
The exception is Nintendo Switch. Minecoins bought there stay with your Nintendo account and can't move to Xbox or PC, so tell your seller if you play on Switch.

faq_extra.q: Can you send Minecoins to a friend?
faq_extra.a: Not directly. Minecraft has no way to move Minecoins between accounts, so the usual way is a Minecoins code your friend redeems.

faq_extra.q: Can you use Minecoins in Java Edition?
faq_extra.a: No. Minecoins and the Marketplace are only in Bedrock Edition.

notes: Prices from third-party summaries (not read from Microsoft's store); gg.deals also lists a 330-coin pack on Xbox/PC, so pack sizes may vary by store. The Switch exception and redeem URL come from third-party guides; help.minecraft.net timed out, so they aren't confirmed there. DELIVERY IS UNCLEAR: config unit_label is 'units' with no bundles or platform fields, the placeholder is generic and there are no live listings. Minecoins can't be transferred, so I assumed code delivery; if sellers top up accounts instead, change the method and set no_password to false. The config FAQ ('game's own trade/gift system') is not true for Minecoins.
